title: Visual Narrative & Content Authoring Workbench
objective: Provide visual graph/object authoring over completed CNI structured content contracts for dialogue, quest, trigger, reusable-content, condition/action, dependency, validation, localization/VO-context, preview/playtest and deterministic-export preparation without creating a parallel narrative runtime or replacing CNI owner authority.

scope.purpose: Provide a first-class visual narrative/content authoring and inspection workbench over CNI-governed structured content rather than requiring direct structured-file editing or creating a parallel narrative runtime.
scope.completion_gate: Representative CNI-governed structured content can be deterministically authored, inspected, validated, previewed and exported through an inspectable workbench projection while CNI remains authoritative for content/narrative runtime and invalid owner/reference/action/dependency states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..09 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.
CNI-05 retained executable-dialogue and governed Action/Event binding authority; PCA-10 compiled dialogue drafts through the CNI-05 contract and never executed effects.
CNI-08 retained quest/scene trigger authority; PCA-10 compiled trigger drafts through CNI-08 and created no scheduler, hidden trigger ledger or callback execution path.
CNI-10 and SMB-16 retained localization/stable-text-key and final product localization authority; PCA-10 carried localization and VO references only as workbench context.
Action/Event and owner domains retained canonical mutation authority; PCA-10 created no narrative runtime, canonical content ledger, owner-domain mutation path or publication authority.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-10 publication. PCA-10 unlocks no interstitial studio/rotation start; MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER. PCA-11 direct gates PCA-02, CNI-06 and CNI-07 are already satisfied, so PCA-11 is the lawful next selected item.
PCA-11 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
